name: Admin Accounting Recurring Payments
description: Superuser manages recurring operational costs at /panel/accounting/recurring: monthly COP total card, monthly USD cost card and a monthly breakdown switchable by category/frequency/payment method. The configured current USD rate is the single source for every USD→COP equivalent; the modal shows a read-only live preview and changing price, currency or frequency recalculates the row, category and general totals after save. The default grouped view lists payments by category with per-group monthly COP subtotals, a grand total, drag-and-drop manual ordering (disabled while a filter is active) and an editable category catalog; a classic view keeps the sortable, paginated table. The frequency catalog runs from monthly through bimestral, trimestral, cuatrimestral, semestral, anual and the every-2/3-years options, plus a "Personalizada" cycle of N months whose form field only appears once it is picked. Every amount is normalized to its monthly equivalent, so a quarterly or custom charge is comparable with a monthly one. A "Gráfico" action beside the view toggle opens a wide charts modal over the same filtered rows — donut by category, ranked bars by item, composition by currency/method/cost type and a calendar of charges by day of month — with the table's active filters shown as chips, an inactive-payments toggle and PNG export. Picking a category (from the legend, a donut slice or the select) drills the whole modal into it: the donut stops splitting by category and splits by the payments inside that one, the legend swaps to those payments — each with its weight inside the category and, muted, its weight over the general total — the center total becomes the category's, and a header names the category and returns to the general view in one click. A category holding a single payment says so by name, so its 100% slice reads as the real breakdown.
